margin_calibration.scope: T_core after TCM, before any TAM update; train/dropout TAM, eval frozen TCM; no_grad

selection_policy.class_counts: exactly half positive and half negative; even batch_size >= 2
selection_policy.scene: independent uniform choice of one eligible scene for each class
selection_policy.pair: uniform choice among original pair indices of that class in the chosen scene
selection_policy.replacement: with replacement iff the chosen class pool is smaller than half the batch
selection_policy.ordering: positive draw, negative draw; merge by scene; shuffle indices then groups
selection_policy.labels: unchanged prepared labels; no source, identity, or temporal filtering

margin_calibration.median_rule: numpy median; mean of two central negative presentations

loss.reduction: float64 diagnostic mean over 4096 presentations, using the training-dtype hinge; equal class weighting, no parameter gradient

margin_calibration.derivative_scope: d loss / d distance only, not parameter gradient; per_example l_i and batch_mean l_i/64

selection_scope: association V_select macro-F1 only; not full-task optimality
resume_reproducibility: bitwise replay requires the same frozen inputs, hardware and software; compatible GPU changes are permitted

selection_policy.class_counts: exactly half positive and half negative; even batch_size >= 2
selection_policy.scene: independent uniform choice of one eligible scene for each class
selection_policy.pair: uniform choice among original pair indices of that class in the chosen scene
selection_policy.replacement: with replacement iff the chosen class pool is smaller than half the batch

selection_policy.labels: unchanged prepared labels; no source, identity, or temporal filtering

sampling.tcm: uniform over training fragments with at least two observed points
sampling.tfm: uniform positive-eligible scene, then uniform positive pair; replacement iff necessary

validation_timing_scope: current invocation; full scoring, threshold selection and selected snapshot CPU copy/metrics; excludes checkpoint I/O
final_evaluation_scope: selected state restore, full association/fusion evaluation and threshold consistency check; excludes summary I/O
timing_note: successful CUDA boundaries synchronize; failed timings stop at exception without waiting for outstanding CUDA work
cuda_memory_scope: current invocation, selected device, process PyTorch allocator peak since pre-model reset; includes existing live allocations/cache; not model-only, whole-device usage or cumulative across resume
